svg.title: Web frameworks: first release, major versions and end of life
svg.desc: One row per framework: bar from the first release to today (dashed for legacy and historical entries), circles at the first stable release of each major version, a cross at the end of life. n/a means no release date could be sourced.

text.tspan: Sources: deps-dev, endoflife-date, hex, maven-central, npm-registry, nuget-registration, official-websites, packagist, site-aspnet-evolution (see the
Bibliography). Data as of 2026-10-27. Registry dates are first publication on the registry, which can be later than the project launch.
